SAFE-MIN-001.verification: Confirmed genuine. L407-415: if [ -n "${CANDIDATE_TAG}" ]; then tag="${CANDIDATE_TAG}" (already semver-validated as ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ before being set as job output); else raw="${GITHUB_REF##refs/tags/}"; tag="$(printf '%s' "${raw}" | LC_ALL=C tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9._-')"; if [ -z "${tag}" ]; then tag="<unknown>"; fi. job-level permissions override is only on the second job; GitHub Actions does not support step-level scoping; the release-gate job therefore cannot access issues:write at any step — SOUND; (4) second-job runner isolation — release-gate-violation-issue runs in a fresh runner with access only to named job outputs (tag, mode strings) from release-gate; L413-414 produces <unknown> on empty result — SOUND; (7) jq filter injection — title constructed from semver-validated CANDIDATE_TAG (^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$) or tr-sanitised fallback (only [A-Za-z0-9._-]); f-strings do not re-evaluate shell metacharacters; RUN_URL is GitHub-runner-provided — SOUND; (9) label pre-create abuse surface — gh label create --force overwrites colour/description only, not name; CODEOWNERS .github/** gates any workflow change; per-repo GITHUB_TOKEN; no org-wide write surface — SOUND; (10) D-037 vs D-029 symmetry — D-037 at DECISIONS.md L49 names precise threat-surface (gh issue create / comment / gh label create --force), bounded behaviour (same-repo Issues namespace only), symmetric rationale structure matching D-029 — SOUND.
